info.title: Pypestream JavaScript SDK API
info.description:
Client-side JavaScript SDK for embedding conversational AI chat interfaces into web applications.

**Note:** This is a client-side SDK, not a REST API. This OpenAPI specification documents the SDK's 
public methods and configurations for documentation purposes.

## Getting Started

Include the SDK script in your HTML:
```html
<script src="https://your-pypestream-domain/config.js"></script>
```

Then use the global `Pypestream` object to interact with the SDK.

## Display Modes

- **Window Mode**: Opens chat in a popup window
- **Inline Mode**: Embeds chat directly in your webpage

post.description:
Shows the chat interface in inline mode only.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
Pypestream.show();
```

**Requirements:**
- Must call `boot()` first
- Only works in 'inline' display mode
- Triggers `onShow` event handlers

value.message: Cannot show chat in display mode 'window'

post.description:
Hides the chat interface in inline mode only.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
Pypestream.hide();
```

**Requirements:**
- Must call `boot()` first
- Only works in 'inline' display mode
- Triggers `onHide` event handlers

Toggles the chat interface visibility in inline mode.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
Pypestream.toggle();
```

**Behavior:**
- Shows chat if currently hidden
- Hides chat if currently showing
- Only works in 'inline' display mode

get.description:
Returns the current visibility state of the chat interface.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
const isVisible = Pypestream.isVisible();
```

post.description:
Completely shuts down and removes the chat interface.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
Pypestream.shutdown();
```

**Behavior:**
- Closes chat interface
- Removes iframe and container elements
- Clears all body scroll locks
- Closes LaunchDarkly client
- Resets boot state
- Can call `boot()` again after shutdown

Restarts the current chat session without shutting down the interface.

**JavaScript Usage:**
```javascript
Pypestream.restartChat();
```

**Behavior:**
- Clears current conversation
- Starts new chat session
- Maintains same configuration
- Keeps interface visible
- Triggers `onChatRestart` handlers

eventHandles.description: Map of event names to handler functions

displayMode.description: Display mode for the chat interface

withInlineAppLoader.description: Show loading animation in inline mode

showSurveyForWindowMode.description: Enable survey in window mode after chat ends
